text.short: Meridian, 1999. A family restaurant named for a woman born in Bizkaia in 1903.
text.today: Five nights, dinner only, five to eight. The house asks you to call or text.
text.history: Founded by the descendants of Maria Epifania Lamiquis-Inchausti — Epi — born 4 February 1903 in Bizkaia.
text.table: Lamb shank as a standing special; solomo, marinated pork loin with pimentos, in a sandwich.

founded.by: the descendants of Maria Epifania Lamiquis-Inchausti

seating.note: Reservations by phone or text; a small room.
